description.text: Specialized Field Offered: Theoretical Economics; Applied Economics; National Economics; Cameralistics; Finance; Statistics; Quantitative Economics

duration.text: The Theoretical Economics at Hunan University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2638 USD/per year ￥ 19000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Letter of recommendation From two full professors or associate professors.

requirements.text: Applicant should gain bachelor's degree or equivalent.
